Services
On-Farm Delivery
Our company-owned fleet of new tractor trailers and ten-wheelers can be quickly dispatched to place or recover feed as needed. With our Lorry Loading system, we can customize your delivery.
Custom Batching
Real-Time adjustments can be made to any formula. We also offer phase feeding and will work with your nutritionist or ours to develop the best rations for each unique animal group.
Complete Tracking & Traceability
We are completely FDA, USDA, and FSMA compliant. Our state-of-the-art system is unparalleled in the industry.
On-Site Testing & Analysis
We grade and test incoming grain for foreign matter, bushel weight, moisture, and toxins using GMO, wet chem, and NIR testing, ensuring top-quality for both ingredients and outgoing feed.

Frequently Asked Questions
What are your receiving hours?
Exeter Feed Mill: 4:30 AM - 9 PM
Aurora: 7 AM - 4 PM
Do you offer a feed that is soy-free?
We do not offer a soy-free option. Soybeans are a great source of protein in animal diets.
What makes our Majestic Express drivers different from other companies’ drivers?
Our drivers have years of experience and are knowledgeable in their profession.
They are dependable, motivated, and have the right attitudes to accomplish any task.
Our company slogan is “Farmers supporting Farmers” and our team of drivers does just that, by being on time for loading/unloading or communicating with the farmers.
Our team gets the job done!
Do you offer bag feed in conventional or non-gmo?
We currently only sell organic feed in 40 lb bags.
How far do you ship your products?
Organic soybean oil is our product that ships the furthest (California).
Feed deliveries stay between Arkansas, Kansas, Missouri, and Oklahoma.
Where are your organic soybeans sourced from?
Majestic primarily sources organic soybeans from local farmers, but we also take deliveries worldwide.
What are the purchasing options for feed?
Majestic offers organic feed in 40 lb bags at select retailers.
Bulk feed can be purchased by the truck for on-farm delivery.
Our standard feed trailers deliver 24 tons.
We have a smaller trailer that will deliver 10 tons.
Call today for pricing.
Exeter Feed Mill: Local Innovation & Top Quality
In 2017, we constructed the state-of-the-art Exeter Feed Mill to address the shortage of organic and non-GMO feed in the market. With an unwavering commitment to the highest standards, we have become a leading supplier of top-quality feed for USDA organic and cage-free egg brands across the Midwest.
Our feed mill is equipped with cutting-edge technology and offers a range of exceptional services:
On-site testing
Custom rations
On-farm delivery
MOA/VISPS verified
Produce 57 products, 17 are non-gmo verified.
100% Automated
Specialize in poultry, swine, and dairy
Learn About Exeter
Aurora Organic Soybean Processing Facility: Growing with Demand
Responding to the rising demand for organic chicken feed, in 2019, we proudly inaugurated the Majestic Organic Soybean Processing Facility.
As a main protein ingredient in organic feed, soybeans play a crucial role in ensuring the health and vitality of livestock.
At our Aurora facility, we showcase:
State-of-the-art equipment and expanded capacity
On-site bean and meal testing
